summary: Robo.ai Inc. (Nasdaq: AIIO), a UAE-based foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K reporting an amendment to its existing convertible note facility. On August 28, 2026, the company amended the July 15, 2026 securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor to extend additional closing deadline to November 30, 2026 and waive certain conditions. The company issued a second senior convertible note of US$12.5 million principal for US$11.5 million purchase price, convertible into Class B ordinary shares at US$2.20 per share, maturing August 28, 2028. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
